751-6006-6633.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

813-2320-3603.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Cloudshift.
813-2320-3603.description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and putting Cloudshift into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Cloudshift to your hand.
Repeat.

3967-4681-5170-8175.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

643-2395-4508-7863.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
643-2395-4508-7863.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers due to Maskwood Nexus, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcom triggers due to Maskwood Nexus, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Quicksmith Genius, causing you to draw a card and discard a card.
Repeat from step 2.

225-1308-3129-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-3668.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-3668.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Flesh Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-3668.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

457-1458-2146-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-2146-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Cloud Key.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1453-4559-5315-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-4559-5315-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1409-2499-5423.description:
Activate Swashbuckler Extraordinaire by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Swashbuckler Extraordinaire enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Swashbuckler Extraordinaire.
Resolve both Swashbuckler Extraordinaire triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3703-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

803-2366-5413-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
803-2366-5413-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1003-3095-6871.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters, Overburden triggers, causing you to return Phyrexian Walker from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

3967-4766-6990.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Michelangelo.
When Michelangelo dies, it and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Michelangelo trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Michelangelo from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

141-2921-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

486-1978-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Forests.
486-1978-5709.description:
Cause Rofellos to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rofellos.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2459-3967-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2438-5220-6535-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

1921-2034-3562.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Sky Hussar from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Sky Hussar token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Sky Hussar token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Sky Hussar token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Sky Hussar token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

4593-4659-6097-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4593-4659-6097-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

2043-2713-3129-4715.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3693-4613-6107.description:
Activate Exemplar of Light by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Exemplar of Light triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

969-2933-4013-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

232-1799-2034-2048.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Priest of Urabrask on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Priest of Urabrask into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

927-4650.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Gorilla Pack to an opponent who controls no Forests.
When Gorilla Pack's controller controls no Forests, Gorilla Pack triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Gorilla Pack cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Gorilla Pack triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

796-1762-2438.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional Zombie creature.
796-1762-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by  sacrificing a Zombie creature.
Wilhelt triggers, creating a 3/3 Zombie token with no abilities due to Poppet Factory.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.
